unit.title: Trustworthy Convex Allocation Solver
learning_objectives: Justify convexity and uniqueness for a quadratic allocation model over a simplex.
Translate a mathematical model into validated, deterministic Python interfaces.
Implement projected gradient descent and Euclidean projection onto a simplex without an optimization package.
Separate mathematical claims, numerical diagnostics, learner tests, and independent validation evidence.
Explain how a small modeling change can invalidate convexity and solver guarantees.

requirements: All deliverables named in student_safe/STUDY_TASK.md are present.
Deterministic checks run in the documented offline Python environment.
An independent examiner applies examiner_only/RUBRIC.md and records at least 80 of 100 points.
A worker-harness-controlled validator promotes the unit result.
